comments.body:
Even when i'm not seaching a legacy, every time i enter in this city i get the message: "The Book of wisdom has reacterd. A discovery related to the legacy theme seems to be lying somewhere within this area. Continue your adventure and try to make your discovery here."

Again, i'm not researching any legacy, still i get this message EVERYTIME i enter Florence.

Someone knows what is it?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I'm afraid this will happen in some zones unless you unlock the appropriate Legacy theme. It is possible to put the word 'legacy' in the search bar of this website and hit enter; doing so will list all current Legacy theme unlock quests (as well as show their pre-quests, if any, and link to their memorial album items, etc.).

But to help save you some time, this is the one you're looking for: Legacy TH4. A Fragrance Envied Even by the Home of Aroma
